_help: Interstitial rules of the Android app, read by installed apps (version 2.3.0 and later) from https://www.maroc-concour.com/app/ads.json at start and every 6 hours: change them here, run npm run build and push, no new Google Play version needed. minGapMs: shortest time between two interstitials; maxGapMs: time of use after which one is shown at the next natural break; setQuestions: smallest set whose end shows one; betweenQuestions: also at the move to the next question (never in exams or timed sets). The app keeps minGapMs and maxGapMs between 90000 (1 min 30 s) and 3600000 (1 h) and setQuestions between 5 and 50; ad units and test mode never come from this file.
